The '''Enclave scientists''' are characters in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Background==
These members of the [[Enclave]] work on various scientific experiments at an [[Enclave research colony]], guarded by several [[Enclave soldier (TV series)|soldiers]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Target]]===
Enclave scientists examine and document newborn puppy dogs; if they do not meet the 10oz weight requirement, they are promptly incinerated. One scientist, [[Siggi Wilzig]], falsifies the weight for the dog [[CX404]] that he was examining.

After some time, the scientists are seen examining and giving injections to the now older puppy dogs while Wilzig takes CX404 into his own care. As Wilzig walks outside, he is scanned by a soldier and sees his fellow scientists training their dogs, while two scientists haul away a [[super mutant (TV series)|mutated corpse]] on a gurney.

==Behind the scenes==
* The unnamed Enclave scientists are portrayed by uncredited background performers.
* In the dog training scene, the extras are noticeably digitally multiplied as more than one scientist each.
